props.children: A quiet address in the heart of old Kyoto.

props.alt: Yasaka Pagoda above a Kyoto street at sunset

props.children:
A little sanctuary.
An entire city at your door.
Behind a discreet entrance, soft light falls across natural timber and linen. Step outside for morning markets, neighbourhood coffee, and the lanes of Higashiyama. This is Kyoto at your own pace.
Go a little further. Stay a little longer.
